gpa.description: Unweighted GPA, 0.0-4.0. Scored, and drives admit tiers.

gpa_weighted.description: Weighted GPA, 0.0-5.0. Displayed only - never scored, never converted to or from the unweighted `gpa`. Deliberately no formula relates the two: high schools weight differently, cap differently, and include different course sets.

culture_prefs.description: Self-reported preference on six bipolar axes. 0.5 means indifferent. Replaces the MBTI-derived personality dimension removed in v2.0.0.

personality.description: Derived from the questionnaire, on axes the culture vector does not cover so no signal is scored twice. 0.5 means no preference.

intensity.description: 0 = steady and low-pressure, 1 = driven and highly competitive.

scale.description: 0 = small and close-knit, 1 = large and bustling.

activities.description: Competitions, clubs and other commitments, matched by keyword against what a school is strong in.

description.description: Feeds recognition only. Each activity still contributes at most one hit.

scope.description: Country scope. A hard filter applied at candidate selection, not a ranking signal, so a requested top_k is still filled.

regions.description: Soft preference folded into the fit dimension. Empty means no preference.

institution_type.description: Hard filter applied at candidate selection.

weights.description: Optional per-request overrides of the default scoring weights.
